josh: Do we have eval regressions on NLU? any hallucination risk with int8?

maria: Config I propose:
```json
{"route_policy":"prefer-dedicated-small","model":"redwood/gpt-lite-int8-v1","canary":{"pct":5,"duration_mins":60},"fallback":"redwood/gpt-base-fp16"}
```

leo: From infra: Dedicated-small has spare capacity in us-west-2, ok to reserve burst slots. Need a canary window aligned with off-peak to monitor memory.

maria: assigning action items: @leo (reserve burst pool, notify infra ops), @sam (customer walk-through + share eval artifacts), @josh (monitor QA metrics). I'll kick the canary at 23:00 UTC if everyone +1.

opsbot: deploybot: Canary scheduled by maria for 3187654380 — will run 60m at 5% traffic.
